name: claude-security
description: Find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers exploit them. A team of agents maps your code, hunts for exploitable flaws and challenges every finding, so you spend your time on real bugs. Get patches analyzed by a panel of agents, and apply them when you choose. Triage other scanners' results, build a threat model, review pull requests with a GitHub Action, and see your hosted Claude Security findings.

live_view.title: Live scan view
live_view.description: Show a live map while a scan runs. For this, the plugin's own code runs inside Claude Code and reads the agents' prompts, calls and answers, the scanned files and your Claude Code settings
